__inputs.name: DS_AZURE_MONITOR
__inputs.description: Use the built-in Azure Monitor data source.
__inputs.label: Azure Monitor

title: nwb-dora-monitoring
description: Production DORA evidence and developer run investigation. Unknown evidence is not zero. See panel descriptions for denominators and coverage.

options.content: Choose **Environment** to see Dev, Test, UAT, Production or another configured target. Release evidence comes from the delivery pipeline; version snapshots come from Azure. These are separate signals. No report means unknown. Production DORA remains below and requires confirmed production evidence.

panels.title: Release operations observed
panels.description: Distinct release IDs per target, including deployment and rollback attempts.

panels.title: Release operations failed
panels.description: Reported deployment or rollback failures. Verification failures are shown separately.

panels.title: Rollbacks observed
panels.description: Rollback operations, including failures; not a production change fail rate.

panels.title: Verification needs attention
panels.description: Includes missing, skipped, failed or cancelled required checks and targets without configured requirements.

panels.title: Latest observed versions | Azure Container Apps
panels.description: Latest retained control-plane snapshot per target; ignores RunId and dashboard dates. Multiple active revisions and containers are shown. A failed read replaces the previous good view; empty values are unknown. This is not continuous runtime verification. Targets never inventoried cannot appear.

panels.title: Release outcomes by environment
panels.description: Deploy and rollback operation outcomes. Required checks are a separate result.

panels.title: Release history | version, actor and source run
panels.description: One operation per stable release ID and resource. Versions are pipeline evidence; use the Azure snapshot to check the latest observed active revisions. RunUrl opens the publishing workflow.

panels.title: Required checks | failed, skipped or missing
panels.description: Checks come from the target requirements and actual pipeline report. Absent required results are missing, never passed. A missing release report cannot establish which tests ran.

panels.title: Rollback history | from version to version
panels.description: Tracks rollback attempts and required rollback verification. OriginalDeploymentId identifies the affected deployment; it is not proof of a production incident or service recovery.

panels.title: All release checks | smoke and post-deployment
panels.description: Passed and non-passed results from configured requirements. These are named check outcomes, not individual assertion counts. Delivery owners implement the tests.

panels.title: Releases without check requirements
panels.description: Add RequiredChecks for the target and operation in release-targets.json. Empty requirements never mean verified.

options.content: Release reporting and inventory must be onboarded for each target. **No data is unknown.** Azure inventory currently covers Container Apps; other hosting platforms need an adapter. Inventory shows observation age and marks snapshots older than 24 hours as stale. Dev/Test results are operational delivery metrics, not production DORA.

**1. Choose a repository and service. 2. Review production delivery. 3. Copy a Build / run ID into the RunId filter to investigate jobs and steps.**

DORA uses confirmed production deployments. RunId filters investigation panels only. Missing evidence shows **Not available**; it is not zero failures. Select one service for a meaningful baseline. Metrics cover retained evidence, not guaranteed complete activity.

panels.title: Deployments / day
panels.description: Observed confirmed production deployments divided by selected elapsed days. No deployment evidence remains unknown.

panels.title: Change lead time | P50
panels.description: Median commit-to-first-production time for linked changes. P50: half of measured changes took this long or less. See coverage below; partial evidence is not a complete baseline.

panels.title: Change fail rate
panels.description: Production deployments requiring intervention / production deployments. Only shown when every observed deployment is classified. CI job failures are not deployment failures.

panels.title: Failed deployment recovery | P50
panels.description: Median recovery time for resolved deployment-related incidents linked to the selected production deployment cohort. Open/invalid recoveries are excluded and counted below.

panels.title: Deployment rework rate
panels.description: Unplanned production deployments to address production incidents / production deployments. Requires explicit rework classification for every observed deployment.

panels.title: Production delivery by day
panels.description: UTC deployment date, not collection date. Zero means no confirmed deployments observed that day; partial days are included.

panels.title: Evidence coverage | check before reporting
panels.description: Coverage is within observed deployments only. A linked change does not prove that all commits were captured. All events are limited by source ingestion and retention.

panels.title: Production delivery by service
panels.description: Compare services separately. Blank rates mean classification is incomplete.

panels.title: Follow a workflow from start to finish

options.content: These panels include CI and non-production runs as well as releases. **Build / run ID** is GitHub RunId; RunNumber is the workflow-local display number. Actor started the original run; TriggeringActor initiated the attempt. Workflow success alone does not prove a deployment or a smoke test passed.

panels.title: Workflow results | all selected attempts
panels.description: One count per repository, run and attempt. Failed attempts remain visible after a successful retry.

panels.title: Run directory | repo, build, actor and result
panels.description: Latest 200 attempts in the event window. RunUrl opens the source workflow. Actor fields need the additive schema update and a fresh collection/replay. SourceTime falls back to source update then collection time when completion is missing.

panels.title: Failed runs | start investigation here
panels.description: Failures, timeouts and action-required results from collected workflow attempts. Cancelled and skipped are separate outcomes in the chart.

panels.title: Jobs | selected build / run
panels.description: Set RunId to narrow to one build. Parallel job durations must not be added to estimate workflow duration. Unmapped means no reviewed stage label.

panels.title: Steps | tests, scans, deployment and verification
panels.description: Latest 500 step observations, ordered within each job. Smoke/post-deployment checks appear only if the application workflow executes them. Step outcome is not individual test-case or vulnerability detail.

panels.title: Post-deployment checks | did the release pass verification?

options.content: Checks must run in the application pipeline and have a reviewed stage mapping. Cards count **jobs**, not individual test cases. Step-only checks appear in the detail panels. A skipped check did not pass; missing checks remain unknown. RunId filters this section.

panels.title: Verification jobs observed
panels.description: Post-deployment verification, smoke-test and rollback-verification jobs in the selected source-event window. Observation does not prove that a deployment happened.

panels.title: Verification jobs failed / timed out
panels.description: Job failures and timeouts. Not a DORA change fail rate. Zero is shown only when at least one mapped verification job was observed.

panels.title: Verification jobs skipped
panels.description: Skipped verification jobs have not executed their checks. Review workflow conditions in GitHub.

panels.title: Smoke-test jobs passed
panels.description: Successful jobs explicitly mapped to Smoke test. This is a job result, not the number of assertions or test cases passed.

panels.title: Verification outcomes | jobs
panels.description: Separate smoke, post-deployment and rollback verification results. Cancelled/skipped results are retained.

panels.title: Checks needing attention | jobs and steps
panels.description: Job and step rows are different levels of the same execution. Do not add their counts. A step can inherit its job stage, including setup and cleanup steps.

panels.title: Post-deployment verification detail | open the source run
panels.description: Includes successful checks and step-only mappings. Source workflow owns the checks and their pass/fail criteria. This dashboard observes their reported outcomes; it does not perform endpoint probes or continuously monitor the application.

options.content: Use the shared stage profile to map the exact verification job or step to **Post-deployment verification**, **Smoke test** or **Rollback verification**. Pre-deployment validation is separate. Publish a fresh run or replay after merging the mapping. No data does not prove that a check passed or was required.

panels.title: Production evidence behind the DORA metrics

options.content: Dates below use source events. Deployment facts are deduplicated by repository and deployment ID. Change and incident facts must link to that deployment ID, service and environment. Replaying a run does not create a new deployment.

panels.title: Confirmed production deployments
panels.description: Successful deployment evidence, not just a successful workflow. Actor comes from the latest observed workflow attempt for the linked URL; it is not an independent deployment audit identity.

panels.title: Change lead time | P50 and P95 by service
panels.description: P50 is the median. P95 means 95% of measured changes were this fast or faster. Small samples are not a reliable performance baseline.

panels.title: Recovery evidence | resolved and incomplete
panels.description: Selected deployment cohort, with any observed recovery through now. Multiple incidents are separate observations. Open, missing and invalid recovery timestamps are excluded from percentiles.

panels.title: Linked changes | commit to first production
panels.description: Only validated timestamp pairs linked to selected production deployments. Lead time is recomputed from timestamps, not a stored duration.

panels.title: Linked incidents | recovery and follow-up
panels.description: Read-only incident evidence. This dashboard neither raises ServiceNow tickets nor runs smoke tests.

options.content: **CI/CD drilldown:** uses collected runs, jobs and steps. **DORA:** requires production mapping, complete linked changes, intervention/rework classification and incident recovery data. The current successful CI ingestion test alone does not validate DORA. See DORA-README.md for onboarding and acceptance checks.
